annotations.title: Link to the PrintPal AI CAD agent

description: Build a printpal.io link that opens the PrintPal AI CAD agent with a design brief prefilled, for users who want to design a functional part with exact dimensions (a bracket, enclosure, adapter or mount) on the website. The brief combines the description, dimensions and material given here with standard printability requirements and the requested export format. This tool does not design anything, does not use credits and does not mean a part exists. Running the agent requires signing in on printpal.io and uses credits from that account. For a figurine or other organic model made here, use prepare_3d_generation instead.

description.description: What the part is and what it must fit/do.

dimensions.description: Known dimensions in mm, e.g. "60 x 40 x 20 mm, M3 holes 50 mm apart".

export_format.description: File format the brief asks the agent to export.

material.description: Intended filament (affects tolerances), e.g. PLA, PETG, TPU.
